description.description-text_1: Hey there, I’m Emre. With a background in Business Informatics and a lot of hands-on experience as a Frontend Developer, I’ve explored many facets of the IT world. Coding is my passion because it's both a logical and creative process, combining problem-solving with design. I draw inspiration from seeing the immediate impact my work has, whether it's making an app run smoother or designing a better user experience. With each coding challenge, I strive for the most practical and elegant solution, learning from every obstacle to keep improving.

description.description-text: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.

implementation-details.implementation-text: The project was built with object-oriented JavaScript, dividing moveable entities, drawable items, levels, and audio into distinct components. The main difficulty lay in keeping animations fluid while managing time-dependent actions like intervals and timeouts. This approach ensured clean code and deepened my experience with animation, timing, and audio coordination.

implementation-details.implementation-text: Join was a team effort by three developers and our first fully Git-managed collaborative project, immersing us in professional development cycles and version control workflows. Using Firebase Realtime Database, tasks and contacts are managed live across devices.  The project showed the importance of strong team coordination in complex software development.

implementation-details.implementation-text: This project marked my first real-world experience with API integration. While I struggled at first with understanding the responses and how to structure them, I gradually built the confidence to query exactly what I needed and integrate it in the right parts of the frontend. This experience showed me how rewarding it can be to transform raw external data into a smooth, interactive user experience.
